comment: sightofanshul.com is canonical. Every other channel already says
'sightofanshul' - the Instagram handle, the brand deck, the logo files - so
the name someone types after watching a video should match the name they
just saw. anshulrastogi.com and the older .xyz redirect to it.
301 and not 308: the spec asks for a 301, and Vercel's `permanent: true`
emits a 308, so the status code is set explicitly.
The redirect is the point. Serving the same pages on both hosts is
duplicate content and splits the SEO signal between two names.
Add every host below to this project in the Vercel dashboard, and take the
apex A record or nameserver values from that dashboard rather than from any
IP written down here - they change and a hardcoded one goes stale silently.
